messages.name: Wonka Industries admin
messages.body: We deleted a draft and now INV-000213 is missing from the sequence. Our auditor asked about it.

messages.name: Leo (Support)
messages.body: That's BUG-2000-04: on 2.0.0, deleting a draft uses up its number. It's fixed in 2.0.1. The gap stays, but the Invoice Register report shows the deleted draft for your auditor.

messages.name: Wonka Industries admin
messages.body: That's not great, but we'll use the workaround.
